selection_reason: All four historical repeat/termination/shared-behavior risks, selected before evaluating the new policy. This is not a representative sample of all bugs.
fixed_grading: Unchanged public + hidden tests, source allowlist, patch-resolved and completed+resolved definitions. All runs retained, including failures.
full_run_gate: Run the unchanged 10-bug/60-trial full suite only after deterministic CI and this targeted evaluation finish reliably; do not select new tasks/seeds based on outcomes.
limitations: Four selected risk tasks, not a general capability estimate
Repeated trials of the same bug are not independent bugs
Historical comparison uses a mutable model alias and is not contemporaneous
Custom runtime is used in paid evaluation; LangGraph parity is tested with deterministic integration cases
